title: Several Charges on the Agreement, and the Span over which They are Read for a Tender
content:
Where more than one settlement charge stands on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the recent two months, the span over which charges are read for a tender widens, and the day of the month the market format is invoiced on settles how far.

## The clause

1. Where the agreement carries at or above 2 settlement charges over the two months to the day the payment is taken, and the market format is invoiced on or after the tenth day of the month, the charges are read over those two months.
2. Where the agreement carries at or above 2 settlement charges over those two months, and the market format is invoiced before the tenth day of the month, the charges are read over the four months to that day.
3. Where the agreement carries fewer than 2 settlement charges over those two months, no such widening is made.

## The boundaries

The multi-charge count is 2 settlement charges over the two months to the day the payment is taken: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. The mid-month cycle day is the 10th: a format invoiced on the 10th, or on any later day of the month, is on or after it, and a format invoiced on the 8th is before it.

| Settlement charges over the two months | Day of the month the format is invoiced on | Charges are read over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 10 or later | the two months to that day |
| 2 or more | 9 or earlier | the four months to that day |
| 1 or none | any | no such widening is made |

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on a format invoiced on the 12th of the month, carrying 3 settlement charges over the two months to the day of payment, reads its charges over those two months. The same three charges on a format invoiced on the 5th are read over the four months to that day.
